## About
Motormania is an independently owned and operated repair center on Ranch Road 620 N in Austin. We specialize in all makes and models of Volkswagen and Audi vehicles, and we have the facilities and know-how for both major repairs and regular maintenance.
We try to make every visit easy, from scheduling to picking up your keys. We keep you posted on your car's progress so nothing comes as a surprise, and we offer a timely, economical alternative to the dealership. Give Roger, Tom, or Matt a call for a free consultation or to set up an appointment.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: All manufacturer recommendations for your model, plus clutch, brake, air conditioning, cooling system, suspension, and transmission services.
- Oil changes: We use only the recommended vehicle-specific oil type and filter for your car.
- Computer diagnostics: Check engine light analysis plus data on engine performance, ABS, air bags, and more.
- Brake systems: Diagnosis and repair of any braking issue, from simple pad replacement to ABS maintenance.
- Transmission services: Full transmission diagnosis and repair, plus maintenance like fluid and filter replacement.
- Timing belt replacement: We replace the timing belt along with the thermostat, water pump, tension rollers, and every other part the belt touches.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Full diagnosis and repair for any air conditioning problem.
- State inspections: State inspections, plus any repairs needed to pass, including emissions systems.

## FAQ
Q: How soon can you see my car?
A: We can usually get you on the schedule within one or two business days.

Q: Should I call before bringing my car in?
A: Yes, please call first. That way we can set a time that works for you and order any parts ahead of your visit.

Q: Will I know what's going on with my car?
A: We keep you informed about your vehicle's progress so there are no surprises at pickup.
